useBlurEffect.name: Use blur effect
useBlurEffect.description: Whether the multitask view applies the blur effect to windows while the view is active. Disabled by default because blurring many full-size windows while the view is closing drops frames.
useBlurEffect.description[zh_CN]: 多任务视图激活期间是否对窗口应用模糊效果。默认关闭，因为视图退出时对大量全尺寸窗口做模糊会导致掉帧。

maxWorkspaces.name: Maximum workspaces
maxWorkspaces.description: Maximum number of workspaces allowed (1-64). When the limit is reached the add button is hidden and no further workspace can be created.
maxWorkspaces.description[zh_CN]: 允许的最大工作区数量（1-64）。达到上限后添加按钮不再显示，且无法继续新建工作区。

animationSpeedMultiplier.name: Animation speed multiplier
animationSpeedMultiplier.description: Uniform speed multiplier applied to every animation (0.1-5.0). 2.0 makes animations twice as fast (duration halved); 0.5 halves the speed (duration doubled).
animationSpeedMultiplier.description[zh_CN]: 作用于所有动画的统一速度倍率（0.1-5.0）。2.0 让动画快一倍（时长减半）；0.5 让速度减半（时长加倍）。

workspaceMoveDurationMs.name: Workspace move duration
workspaceMoveDurationMs.description: Base duration in milliseconds (16-5000) of workspace move animations such as workspace switching and sliding.
workspaceMoveDurationMs.description[zh_CN]: 工作区切换、滑动等工作区移动动画的基准时长，单位毫秒（16-5000）。

windowChangeDurationMs.name: Window change duration
windowChangeDurationMs.description: Base duration in milliseconds (16-5000) of window animations such as appearing, changing and aligning.
windowChangeDurationMs.description[zh_CN]: 窗口出现、变化、对齐等窗口类动画的基准时长，单位毫秒（16-5000）。

viewEnterDurationMs.name: View enter duration
viewEnterDurationMs.description: Base duration in milliseconds (16-5000) of the multitask view enter and exit animation.
viewEnterDurationMs.description[zh_CN]: 多任务视图进场/退场动画的基准时长，单位毫秒（16-5000）。
